sources.locator: "Treaty of the Bulls of Guisando", revision 1351645852

explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of the Bulls of Guisando" (revision 1351645852) says: "This was one of the events that eventually led to the War of the Castilian Succession a few years later." The edge reads that sentence as: Treaty of the Bulls of Guisando caused War of the Castilian Succession, and nothing more.
